news.headline: Brent Crude breaches $101/bbl on US-Iran tensions — 8th consecutive session of gains
news.what_happened: US struck Iranian oil tankers in the Gulf; Iran retaliated near Hormuz Strait. Brent rose above $101/bbl and WTI reached $96.48, marking 8 straight sessions of oil gains.
news.why_it_matters: For India, rising crude widens the current account deficit and raises inflation risk. Airlines (jet fuel ~35-40% OPEX), paints, tyres, logistics all face direct cost pressure. Benefits ONGC/OIL (higher realization per barrel) and OMC (short-term inventory gains).

news.headline: US markets fall 3rd consecutive day — S&P -0.48%, Dow -0.77%, Nasdaq -0.64%
news.what_happened: S&P 500 closed at 7,636 (-0.48%); Dow dropped 405 points (-0.77%). US 10-Year Treasury yield climbed to 4.837%, highest in recent weeks. Oil and rate fears drove selling across sectors.
news.why_it_matters: Risk-off globally signals FII outflows from India. Rising US yields make EM assets less attractive, adding to FII selling pressure (4th consecutive day). Large-cap Nifty stocks with high FII ownership face headwinds.

news.headline: Cabinet approves 3 railway multitracking projects worth ₹10,783 Cr
news.what_happened: Union Cabinet cleared three railway multitracking projects worth ₹10,783 crore to ease rail network congestion, boost freight movement, and improve connectivity to nearly 4,790 villages.
news.why_it_matters: Direct government capex injection into railway infrastructure. RVNL, as the primary designated executor of Indian Railway capital projects, stands to gain directly from this order pipeline.

news.headline: FII net sellers ₹583 Cr (4th day); DII buy ₹1,509 Cr providing floor support
news.what_happened: Foreign Institutional Investors offloaded a net ₹582.99 Cr in the cash segment on September 9. Domestic institutions (LIC, mutual funds) absorbed ₹1,509 Cr. Nifty closed at 23,431.5 (-0.86%).
news.why_it_matters: Persistent FII selling over 4 sessions indicates institutional exit from India amid global risk-off. DII buying is limiting the downside but cannot fully offset the trend. Market breadth likely to remain weak.

news.headline: RBI holds repo rate at 5.25%; neutral stance maintained
news.what_happened: The Monetary Policy Committee unanimously voted to keep the repo rate at 5.25%, SDF at 5.0%, and MSF/Bank Rate at 5.50%. Neutral stance retained. GDP growth projected at 6.9% for FY26-27.
news.why_it_matters: No rate cut removes a near-term catalyst for banking, NBFC, and real estate sectors. With US 10Y yield rising, RBI's neutral stance is prudent but limits upside for rate-sensitives.

picks.catalyst: Brent crude above $101/bbl (+0.11%), WTI at $96.48 (+0.45%) on sustained US-Iran geopolitical tensions — 8th consecutive session of oil gains
picks.logic: ONGC is India's largest upstream oil producer. Every $1 rise in crude improves annual profit by ~₹1,500-2,000 Cr. Brent at $101 with active geopolitical supply risk creates a strong direct realization catalyst. Stock near 52-week low zone (₹227 base) offers technical support. Direct P&L impact — not sentiment-driven.

picks.catalyst: Cabinet approved 3 railway multitracking projects worth ₹10,783 Cr — direct government capex translating into fresh order pipeline
picks.logic: Rail Vikas Nigam Ltd is the primary designated executor of Indian Railway capital projects. Cabinet-level approvals typically convert into Letters of Acceptance for RVNL within weeks. Stock down 25%+ from 6-month highs at ₹207.5 — risk-reward is attractive at current levels. Government capex stocks can outperform even in weak markets when specific order news is the catalyst.
